problem.original_text: Compute the area of the region enclosed by $$y=x^2$$ and $$y=2x+3$$. Include a plot shading the region.

steps.title: Set up area integral
steps.explanation: Area between curves = integral from left to right of (top - bottom) dx. Top is 2x+3, bottom is x^2 on [-1,3].

steps.title: Compute the integral
